description: apb: in an apb project (docs/MAP.md) or the apb repo itself (hooks/apb_folder.py), append one line per event to .apb/events.jsonl, so the orchestrator can see what agents are doing and time each step. Keep the watcher (scripts/apb-watch.py) running for the orchestrator, on the project's repo and the coordination issue (a second watcher when that issue is in another repo), and wake it when a watcher finds something. When the orchestrator's work runs out, its message must say who holds the ball, and a GitHub fact it states must come from a lookup in the same turn (gh, git, or the map or progress-page script). A hand-off of an apb PR that touches templates/, hooks/, agents/, a skill's SKILL.md or docs/playbook.md is sent back once if the PR's description has no "Projects:" line. A turn is also sent back once for more than one ask line, prose after its ask, an open ask repeated with no word from the human, or a "Nothing for you to do" line while nothing runs; and, when it hands something over or starts an agent, for anything the end-of-turn check (scripts/consistency-check.py) finds where the board and GitHub disagree, which on a GitHub error lets the turn end and says it couldn't run. A brief to a builder or reviewer that tells it how to format or post its work is refused; a report that says it departed from its file sends back every hand-off to the human, up to 3 times a turn, until the orchestrator resolves it. At session start, and in a watcher's wake after a merge, say when main's apb plugin is newer than the session's. At session start in the apb repo, also pull a main that is only behind origin/main (a clean fast-forward), or say when the checkout is off main or behind and can't be pulled. At session start, in the orchestrator's checkout, give the startup self-check (hooks/apb-selfcheck.py): one block, a line each for the watcher, the GitHub account, the board, the hooks and the version, ✅ or ❌, headed by the session's name (apb orch N · version · start time).
